_comment: Hole circles of standard index plates for simple indexing (K = 40). Checked on 2026-11-19 against the sources below; pending the user's approval (spec §3, §10.4).

sources: TTE-LISA, CME29 Milling, Indexing.pdf (text: 'Brown and Sharpe type consists of 3 plates of 6 circles each'): https://tte-lisa.ac.uk/wp-content/uploads/vle_content/Phase2/mechanical/CME29/Resource/Milling/Indexing.pdf
US Army, Milling Machine Operations OD1644, lesson 1 task 1: https://armyordnance.tpub.com/od16448/od164480029.htm
hobby-machinist.com forum (same circles, attributed to Ellis heads): https://www.hobby-machinist.com/goto/post?id=113030
sets.note: Spec §10.4 mentions one source adding a 35-hole circle to plate 3; not found in the sources above, so not included.
